pyramiding_rule: Strict prohibition of averaging down or clustering multiple entries within a 1-dollar price band during high-velocity market impulses.
new_mandatory_entry_filter: Require a 3-bar volume-weighted average price (VWAP) confirmation and zero high-impact news impulses within a +/- 15-minute window before order dispatch.
profit_harvest_threshold: Initiate aggressive trailing or partial scaling whenever floating profit reaches $10.00 to prevent erosion back to negative territory.
